test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
T, U, V, W, X, and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). U is sitting third to the right of V, who is sitting second to the left of W. Y is not an immediate neighbour of U. T is sitting to the immediate left of V.

Who is sitting to the immediate left of T?
solution:
Given, T, U, V, W, X, and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

U is sitting third to the right of V, who is sitting second to the left of W.
